description: Covers B17, B18. Port the Python host tests of the moved tools (pc_deploy, ctl, acceptance, the ESF tools, job.sh) from napoleon to the null game, so a core change is tested here (B17); a core Git Bash finder that harness/ctl.py uses instead of the game's tools/verbs/setup.py, and that a game's setup verb can reuse (B18).
title: Harness host tests in the core and its own Git Bash finder
